description: The Public Service Commission - Delegation of Powers by the Public Service Commission that should be effective from 03.11.2015
categorisation: This gazette notification is about the Public Service Commission delegating powers related to transfers and disciplinary control of public officers to various Ministry Secretaries. It deals specifically with public service administration, recruitment procedures, and disciplinary matters within the civil service, which falls under the Public Service Gazettes category (Type 8). While it mentions government positions, it does not focus on structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would classify it under Types 1-3.
